notes:
Summary: Large mid-enterprise support SaaS. Primary goal = aggressive ticket deflection via RAG + rerank while keeping push-button latency SLOs. Customer owns historical ticket store ~12M tickets + 40M short-form KB snippets (sliced, per-product). They want: fast top-5 quality reranking for chat and ticket classification, predictable cost per query, and EU residency for PII-sensitive records.

Key quotes: 'If top-5 returns are noisy we lose deflection — need high precision at 1-5', 'Latency budget is tight; we need 95th < 300ms end-to-end on peak flows or fallback to cached answer'.

Technical constraints / notes: prefer managed embedding store but evaluating dedicated cluster to guarantee throughput during enterprise weekly batch peaks. Current embedding dim preference 1536 or 1024 (open to quantized vectors). Existing infra: Azure + Google for analytics, legal wants VPC peering for POC. SOC2 required, ISO discussion later.

Commercial: price sensitivity around cost-per-query — target <$0.005/query for typical 1–3 retrievals + rerank. Will trade some latency for cost in non-peak buckets. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching and quantization.
